review_notes: Three accounts describe the June 5 04:55 Charkilo slide obstructing Narayangadh–Muglin traffic; the slide two days earlier is separate background.
The dry slide at Hedangna, Makalu-3 blocked the Khandbari–Kimathanka road and buried an excavator, injuring its assistant; road blockage is the recorded incident.
The September 30 evening debris-laden slide at Tuin Khola, Ichchhyakamana-5 obstructed both directions of the Narayangadh–Muglin road.
The report locates a previous-evening slide at Tophe Khola near Ichchhyakamana-5 that left the Narayangadh–Muglin highway shut for 12 hours.
A slide with large boulders fell at Sirubari, Raghuganga-2, obstructing the Beni–Jomsom road; machinery was being sent to restore traffic.
Dry sliding from about 04:00 at Kudule, Golanjor-1 halted traffic on the Khurkot–Ghurmi Mid-Hill Highway section; continued falls refer to that location.
The October 2 dry slide at the Zero–Dhobidhara section of Mechi Highway in Ilam-8 stopped vehicles and carried away roughly half the road.
The source identifies a rain-triggered slide at Bhattadi, Raskot-8, that blocked the Karnali Highway; the recorded impact is highway obstruction.
The slide near Jugga Khola, Nishikhola-2, obstructed the Burtibang–Rukum section of Mid-Hill Highway and stranded traffic.
Slide debris at Gurje Bhanjyang stopped traffic on Chhahare–Tokha Road from the night preceding the July 31 report; the incident is a road obstruction.
The April 29 report places a same-morning slide at Bimire Bhanjyang, MadhyaNepal-10, blocking travel on the Mid-Hill Highway.
The Ghumaune slide struck the Muglin–Narayangadh road at 10:00 on April 3, buried nine vehicles and killed two; the report centers on the roadway failure.
The July 18 Lasti Berneta landslide destroyed two houses; rescuers recovered the body of 16-year-old Bikash Pariyar, establishing one fatality.
The slide at Nagurdun, Kalika-1, brought down about 25 metres of Pasang Lhamu Highway and halted container traffic; this is a road obstruction.
The October 8 20:30 dry slide by the Khani Khola bridge at Satrakilo narrowed Narayangadh–Muglin traffic to one lane; earlier slides are contextual.
The Pipalbot house slide killed Geeta Thapa; the same account reports her mother as injured, not deceased. Only one death is established.
The July 24 renewed slide at Charkilo obstructed the Narayangadh–Muglin road; earlier events there are reported as prior incidents.
The August 21 slope collapse beyond Nagdhunga checkpoint toward Tileghar blocked both directions; the documented incident is road obstruction.
The 04:30 slide from above the road at Chor Khola, Kapurkot-3, buried and blocked Rapti Highway; Dang is only the dateline.
The Manewa, Righa slide toppled live electricity poles; Mana Kumari Nepali died after being struck/electrocuted by a fallen pole, giving one event-linked death.
A reported slide at Tuin Khola completely stopped the Narayangadh–Muglin road; the article concerns closure and alternative routes.
Two people died when a man-made soil bank at Ishara pond collapsed while earth was being dug; this is an excavation cave-in, not a natural landslide.
The August 8 early-morning mud slide at Kalikhola, Ichchhyakamana-6, blocked both directions of Narayangadh–Muglin road; the reports describe this same road incident.
Rain-triggered slide debris and falling stones at Siddhababa, Palpa, blocked Siddhartha Highway from early June 1; Butwal is merely the dateline.
The landslide at Dharigad blocked the Gothalapani–Jhulaghat section of Dasharath Chand Highway, leaving vehicles stranded.
The July 26 afternoon slide at Laborbote, Sangurigadhi-1, deposited debris on Koshi Highway and obstructed traffic.
The March 30 account reports a fresh Sunday-morning slide on the Mechi Highway in Ilam that blocked the road; a narrower locality is not supplied.
A sewer-trench excavation wall collapsed on two workers in Balkot, Suryabinayak-2; one later died. This is a trench cave-in, not a natural slope failure.
The August 21 ~20:00 dry slide at Tophe Khola, Ichchhyakamana-6, closed both lanes of Narayangadh–Muglin road.
The September 3 ~07:50 slide at Panchkilo, Ichchhyakamana-6, obstructed Narayangadh–Muglin road in both directions.
The morning landslide at Tuwachung, Halesi Tuwachung-7, obstructed Diktel–Jayaram road and stranded vehicles.
The slide buried a temporary shelter at Majhgaun, Nalagad-2, killing Lal Bahadur Pariyar, his wife Manisha and their young son: three fatalities.
The Kamidanda house slide killed Basuna Sunar; her granddaughter was reported missing at publication, not a confirmed second fatality.
The Mini-Gosainkunda slide killed pilgrim Namrata Karki and injured another; the cited ten deaths refer to other incidents district-wide over a month.
The previous-night debris-laden slide near Ghumaune, Bharatpur-29, blocked both directions of Muglin–Narayangadh road.
The August 7 night slide at Budhitola, Godawari-4, undermined about 200 metres of Bhimdatta Highway; continued sliding extended the blocked section.
The two sources place a July 30 09:00 mud slide at Kalikhola, Ichchhyakamana-6, blocking Narayangadh–Muglin road; subsequent small falls impeded clearing.
Both reports identify the July 20 ~05:00 Charkilo, Ichchhyakamana-6, slide that blocked Narayangadh–Muglin road; earlier failures are only history.
